register.labelZh: PUT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: PUT 片語動詞也可以用來表達想法、顯示優先次序、估計數字和解釋原因。；你可以 put things away 或 back、put a plan together、put a date forward,或 put an event off。；PUT 片語動詞可以表示貶低、慫恿、造成不便、施加壓力、提供住宿和忍受。；飛機可以 put down,船隻可以 put in 或 put out,乘客可以被 put on 交通工具,而來電者可以被put through。
register.summaryEn: PUT expressions can communicate ideas, show priorities, estimate numbers and explain causes. You can put things away or back, put a plan together, put a date forward or put an event off. PUT expressions can show criticism, encouragement, inconvenience, pressure, accommodation and tolerance. Planes can put down, ships can put in or put out, passengers can be put on transport, and callers can be put through.
